content: Yeypp guye, taanii be7eeza, salo dooyintteez penge yeza. Ma ta tiina si7eez tulitulo girss garkkezay taako, «Yhankka kezoba; yhaypp guye, hanodayis yeza baz ta nena beezoda» yeegeeza.
Ye wode ta Ayyanar kumii yeza. Yikkee, salo zufaane be7eeza zufaanayil afa petta beteezana be7eeza.
Ye betteezay malay iyasiphedennee sarddiyoona giz al7o shuchchay garkk. E zufaanay yuushayid al7o mergede shuchch aaziz zuullay yeza.
Ye zufaanay yuushayid laatamannee oydd zufaanitay yeza; unttal afa booth ma7o ma77ii, ommal worqqa zawude gaddeez laatamannee oydd cimitay betteeza.
Zufaanaypp zeelinth, dada guumthinnee saaritha keziza. Zufaane tiina laappun poo7iza tama xomppitay yeza; unttii laappun Xooss ayyanita.
Zufaanay tiina birille aaziza fociz burccuko abbay yeza. Tiinarannee guyer aafe kumeez shemppor yez oyddii medhetithitay zufaanay yuushayirannee zufaanay gancce yeza.
Tiina medhetithay gaammo aaziza; nam7inthay gemate aaziza; hayidzanthay tiinayir as aaziza; ma oyddinthay piradhdhiza ankko aaziza.

Oydd medhetethitay pettayis pettayis usuppun qefitay yeza; ye qefitay afa baggarannee oommo baggar aafe kumeeza. Unttii qammannee gallas gachchekka, «Geeshshayyo, geeshshayyo, geeshshayyo, Godayyo, Ubba haariza Xoossayo, Binkka, yhattekka yezayo, tiinapp ye7odayyo» gachchekkazar yeegiza.
Ye medhetethitay zufaanayil beteezayinnee medhinas yezayis Saaba, bonchchonnee galata inggeez wode
laatamannee oydd cimitay zufaanel beteezannee medhinas yezay tiina xuggunii goynneeza; fa zawude zufaanay tiina gaddii,

content.text: ubba baz ne shene garkk haneezay garkk
neenii bonchcho, teemannee wolqqa ekkodayis beeziza»
